stages.label: Vanke's Restructuring Planning & White Knight Search
stages.summary: Between December 22, 2015 and June 30, 2016, Vanke carried out restructuring planning and sought white knight investors as a defensive response to Baoneng Group's hostile takeover attempt, after Baoneng became Vanke's largest shareholder.

stages.label: Initial Share Acquisition & Public Confrontation
stages.summary: This stage represents the initial phase of the Baoneng-Vanke takeover battle, running from July 2015 to December 21 2015, encompassing three core developments: Baoneng Group's accumulation of Vanke shares to become its largest shareholder, Vanke senior management's public opposition to Baoneng's takeover attempt, and Vanke's suspension of share trading for capital restructuring.

stages.label: Multilateral Standoff & Conflict Escalation
stages.summary: This stage of the Baoneng-Vanke takeover battle commences in early July 2016 with the resumption of Vanke's share trading after a six-month suspension, which saw Vanke's Shenzhen-listed shares tumble by the 10% daily limit on the first trading day. Following Vanke's announcement of a 45.6 billion yuan asset restructuring plan with Shenzhen Metro Group that would make Shenzhen Metro the largest shareholder, Baoneng proposed ejecting Vanke's entire senior management team including founder Wang Shi, a proposal that was subsequently voted down by Vanke's board.

stages.label: Conflict Resolution & Battle Conclusion
stages.summary: This stage, spanning from early June 2017 to June 30 2017, constitutes the final resolution phase of the two-year Baoneng-Vanke takeover battle that launched in July 2015, formalizing the end of the high-profile control dispute over Vanke.
